description: Ask a person to approve a domain, deploy, function, bucket, database, API action, Galon plan or a balance top-up. Use when buying a domain, promoting a deploy, proposing a plan or top-up, deploying a function, opening a bucket or creating a database. Before: an OAuth app connection, not an API key; the id the action needs. Never send a transfer code. Returns the pending request and its console_url to give the person; then wait. Cost: free to ask; a purchase is charged only after the person approves it in the console (a plan or top-up is paid by the person; a domain is paid with a payment method, never from the balance).

action.description: What the person approves: buy, renew or transfer in a quoted domain, restore an expired domain of this project (domain.restore: the person pays with a payment method in the console), choose a production plan, promote a deploy, subscribe to a Galon plan (plan.checkout), top up the prepaid balance (wallet.topup), deploy or delete a function (functions.deploy, functions.delete), make a bucket public (storage.bucket_public), create a database (backend.create) or turn on its data API (backend.data_api), run one action of galon_actions that needs approval (api.call: copy the request_approval of the galon_call refusal), or create, start or delete a virtual machine (compute.create, compute.start, compute.delete: the person sets the machine's spend cap; it stops at the cap), delete a hosted database or restore it within its 7 days of grace (backend.delete, backend.restore: always approved by a person on the Galon page). For plan.checkout and wallet.topup the person pays on a secure payment page; you never pay.

premium_accepted_minor.description: Premium price accepted, in USD cents.

registrant.description: Owner contact: first_name, last_name, email, phone, address.

domain.description: Domain name of this project to renew (domain.renew) or, once expired, to restore (domain.restore).

quote_id.description: Quote id from the quote_domain job (requires Domains access), operation renew, or restore for domain.restore.

confirmations.description: The four checks, each true only if the person confirmed it. Never the transfer code.

domain_unlocked.description: The domain is unlocked at its current registrar.

email_access_confirmed.description: The owner can read the registrant email.

owner_consent_confirmed.description: The domain owner agrees to the transfer.

terms_accepted.description: The owner accepts the transfer terms.

quote_id.description: Quote id from the quote_domain job (requires Domains access), operation transfer.

registrant.description: Owner contact: first_name, last_name, email, phone, address.

renewal_quote_id.description: Optional quote id, operation renew, for the renewal after the transfer.

plan_id.description: Production plan id, e.g. site or pro (deploy.plan).

journey_id.description: Deploy id from start_deploy (requires Deploy access), for deploy.promote.

plan.description: Galon plan to subscribe to (plan.checkout); prices in get_pricing and the instructions.

amount.description: Top-up amount in USD cents, e.g. 2500 for $25.00 (wallet.topup); within the minimum and maximum of one top-up.

name.description: Function name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (functions.deploy).

source_ref.description: source_ref from upload_function_source (needs functions deploy access).

source_sha256.description: source_sha256 from upload_function_source (needs functions deploy access); checked against the uploaded code.

revision_sha256.description: Revision to delete, from get_function_job (needs job read access).

plan.description: starter: the free database of the plan (default); hosted: billed per hour (backend.create).

database_id.description: Database id from list_databases (needs database read access), for backend.delete or backend.restore.
Database id from list_databases (needs database read access), for backend.data_api.

schema.description: Schema the data API serves; public by default.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key of the call, reused when it runs (api.call).

operation_id.description: Action id of the API action to run (api.call).

params.description: The action parameters, as in the approval_required refusal (api.call).

flavor.description: Machine size, as in the quote (compute.create).

image.description: Operating system image, as in the quote (compute.create).

name.description: Host name of the machine to create (compute.create).

quote_id.description: Machine quote id from quote_compute_instance (needs compute quote access) (compute.create).

ssh_key_ids.description: 1 to 5 key ids from list_ssh_keys (needs compute read access) or add_ssh_key (needs compute write access) (compute.create).

instance_id.description: Machine id (vm_...) to start (compute.start) or delete (compute.delete).

input.description: The fields of the chosen action.
